scope: Pinned panic and backend helpers, four-kilobyte shared ring layout; autoflush/enable ordering, empty/permuted lists and callback next/head mutations
limitations: Backend panic callbacks are fixtures; production backend registration/data and transport shutdown remain unproven.
The 4128-byte source footprint matches native cold RAM; fields unused by panic require their own dequeue/standard/init contracts.
Acyclic bounded lists only; complete frontend, concurrency, physical logger transport and image equality remain open.
